title: Grid scrolling, resizing and keys
scenario: A Grid of 2,048 rows: 100 wheel notches, 60 fractional touchpad deltas, 30 column-resize steps, 200 arrow keys; then a grouped model with a select-all (default variant 20,000 rows in 1,000 groups; receipt-only grouped-full 200,000 rows in 10,000 groups). Proves G3, G8, G13 (cells).
drawCalls: counted per step by the counting COM wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: nothing changes: the first frames lay out the Grid

phases.name: wheel
phases.description: one wheel notch toward the end over the Grid's centre

phases.name: touchpad
phases.description: a fractional wheel delta of 40 (a third of a notch) toward the end

phases.name: resize
phases.description: step 0 hovers and presses on the first column's divider, steps 1-28 drag it 2 DIP right, step 29 releases

phases.name: arrows
phases.description: step 0 focuses the Grid and its first row; every step presses and releases Down

phases.name: grouped-wheel
phases.description: step 0 swaps in the grouped model; every step scrolls one wheel notch toward the end

phases.name: select-all
phases.description: select-all over the grouped model (Extended selection)

phases.name: selected-arrow
phases.description: Down with every row selected: each key replaces the whole selection

videoMemory.reason: software adapter: rendering uses system memory, which privateBytes counts

memory.trackedLiveBytes: measured from the scene build onwards

timing.reason: timing comes only from performance-timing.ps1 on a hardware adapter in a quiet window (W0.2); counts and memory are recorded here

provenance.command: performance-fixtures.ps1 -Fixture FX3 -Variant grouped-full -Adapter Warp -FixtureHost embedded -Configuration 'Release' -Platform x64
